messages:
sophie_support: FYI customer (acme-eu) opened an urgent erasure ticket — they say some vectors and embeddings still show up in their dedicated tenant after we reported deletion completed. They attached a few API call IDs.

matt_eng: can you paste the call ids + model / route? also which deployment (dedicated vs private)?

sophie_support: Dedicated EU tenant (tenant_id: tidy-acme-eu). Call IDs: call_2026_03_10_114522, call_2026_03_10_115003. Customer says billing still shows token charges for calls after our erase timestamp.

matt_eng: ok. first suspects: cache/KV prefix not cleared or KMS unwrap failed during background purge. can you fetch the server-side delete job logs for that tenant? command i usually run: `rbx-admin tenant-jobs tail --tenant tidy-acme-eu --job erase --since 2026-03-10T11:00Z`

sophie_support: attaching the excerpt customer provided: ```
2026-03-10T11:45:23Z INFO erase-job started tenant=tidy-acme-eu job_id=job-987
2026-03-10T11:45:24Z ERROR kms: decrypt failed key=projects/prod/keys/acme-eu reason=AccessDenied
2026-03-10T11:45:24Z WARN skipping blob id=bv_12345 due to kms error
2026-03-10T11:46:01Z INFO erase-job completed tenant=tidy-acme-eu deleted=148 skipped=3
```

rami_security: AccessDenied from KMS during erase is a red flag. we need the KMS audit log (who called, IP, principal). is this our managed KMS or customer-managed CMK?

sophie_support: Customer says they use Redwood-managed keys but linked to their HSM provider via subproc chain (thirdparty-hsm-inc). They provided a screenshot of a 403 in their console.

elena_privacy: for the GDPR audit we must produce a deletion timeline and evidence for each data category. if blobs were skipped due to kms errors we have to show remediation and confirm re-erase. also confirm role (controller/processor) in our DPA — customer is controller, we are processor.

deb_ops: I can run a scan to list remaining objects and verify encryption key metadata. running: `rbx-admin storage list --tenant tidy-acme-eu --prefix embeddings/ --format json`

support-bot: Ticket #TKT-21132 updated: priority -> high, label -> gdpr-erasure. Assigned to sophie_support.

matt_eng: quick repro attempt: call the same route with the call ids and then check kv cache status: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" https://api.redwood.run/v1/tenants/tidy-acme-eu/objects/call_2026_03_10_114522` response should be 404 if erased. if 200, check `x-cache-hit` header and `x-kv-key` header. also check model routing logs to see if subsequent inference calls were served from cached prefix.

sophie_support: customer ran the curl and got 200 for one of the call objects (call_2026_03_10_115003). Response headers: `x-cache-hit: true`, `x-kv-key: kv-prod-7`

matt_eng: that suggests KV prefix cache persisted after erase. erase job should clear prefix cache keys as part of post-delete hook. need to know if the erase job reached the cache invalidation step or aborted on KMS error. attach full erase job log if possible.

rami_security: also collect KMS audit entries for `Decrypt`/`UnwrapKey` around 2026-03-10T11:45Z. vendor chain: thirdparty-hsm-inc -> cloud-kms-proxy -> redwood-kms. need principal/subject. please include `authorizationInfo` and requestMetadata fields from the logs.

elena_privacy: while we triage, we must tell the customer we are investigating and that skipped items will be re-queued. get explicit consent to access tenant diagnostic data for compliance paperwork.

sophie_support: I asked the customer for permission to access tenant diagnostics and for a signed DPA excerpt. also asked for the exact billing window where they see tokens after erase. they responded: charges on 2026-03-10 12:00-12:30 UTC ~ 3.4k tokens.

deb_ops: scan output (partial): ```
{"id":"call_2026_03_10_115003","blob":"s3://redwood-prod/tenants/tidy-acme-eu/embeddings/bv_12345","kms_key":"projects/prod/keys/acme-eu","cached":true}
{"id":"call_2026_03_10_116000","blob":"s3://redwood-prod/...","kms_key":"projects/prod/keys/acme-eu","cached":false}
```

matt_eng: plan: 1) fetch complete erase-job log + job state (succeeded/partial) 2) fetch KMS audit for those timestamps 3) requeue any skipped blobs to erase-queue (with deterministic backoff) 4) invalidate KV cache manually for affected keys 5) produce an evidence bundle (logs + commands) 6) confirm re-run completed and report to customer. I can take 1/3/4.

rami_security: I'll pull KMS audit and confirm whether the 403 was because of a revoked subproc token or transient network failure. if it's a vendor auth issue we need to update subprocessor status in our inventory and notify compliance.

infra-oncall: pinged and will review the erase-job trace. if you need immediate cache kill: `rbx-admin cache invalidate --keys kv-prod-7 --tenant tidy-acme-eu` (this is destructive, do only for affected keys).

sophie_support: customer gave access. attaching their consent: "ACME hereby consents to Redwood accessing tenant tidy-acme-eu diagnostics for purposes of investigating erasure request TKT-21132."

elena_privacy: keep a copy of that consent in the ticket. we'll need it for the DPA audit. after remediation confirm with a signed attestation that remaining personal data was erased.

matt_eng: executing step 4 now (manual invalidate) for the reported `kv-prod-7`. will also requeue blob bv_12345.

support-bot: Job requeue created job_id=job-1003 for tenant=tidy-acme-eu blobs=1

matt_eng: requeue success. invalidate command returned 200. verifying access to blob endpoint...

sophie_support: customer confirms `curl` now returns 404 for call_2026_03_10_115003. billing team, can you correlate token charges with cache-hit responses? they show 3.4k tokens at 12:15 UTC.

billing: (cc @sophie_support) looking. if cached responses were served after erase but before billing frontier closed, we may need to apply an adjustment. need raw request ids tied to billing window.

elena_privacy: once we produce the evidence bundle we should include: - erase-job logs (full) - KMS audit entries - cache invalidation command outputs - customer consent - final verification curl (404) timestamps.

rami_security: one follow-up: vendor chain shows thirdparty-hsm-inc had an expired service credential at 11:43Z causing UnwrapKey 403s. vendor says they rotated creds and apologized. we need to update subprocessor inventory and add an incident note in vendor file.

sophie_support: will update ticket and inform customer of remediation timeline and next steps. action items: matt to assemble evidence bundle, rami to attach KMS audit, deb to include storage scan, billing to confirm adjustment, elena to prepare DPA attestation template.

matt_eng: assembling bundle now, ETA 2 hours. attaching `evidence_bundle.zip` to ticket when done.

sophie_support: thanks all. I'll close loop with customer after bundle uploaded. :white_check_mark:

infra-oncall: noted. follow-up: we'll add an automated health check for subproc KMS auth to catch this earlier. :eyes:
